report:
Reviewed the complete meta.book.anchor_moves claim and both implementation associations plus all three test associations. Independently verified exact byte equality of both current associated files against both historical implementation_sources and test_sources; this supports reuse of unchanged evidence, not automatic reuse of the verdict.

The ordinary book::redirects association supplies published compatibility links. apply reads the redirect manifest, computes relative destinations, preserves active chapter content while adding fragment redirects, and writes retired HTML pages without inserting canonical chapters. script prefers fragment-specific aliases and preserves unrecognized fragments on default moves; document includes usable links. Captured chapter_url, relative_url and book_source_root helpers establish README/index matching, destination calculation, and configured source location. The active_landing_pages_keep_content_and_only_redirect_retired_fragments test asserts original content, null default, the exact relative old-fragment destination, and no replacement file. The retired_pages_have_relative_default_and_fragment_redirects test asserts generated output, exact default and fragment destinations, fragment-preservation script, unchanged empty canonical chapter list, and stable repeated output. These assertions would detect wrong relative destinations, overwritten live content, or inserted canonical chapters. Browser execution is not asserted by these source tests.

The spec_plan.rs todo implementation and moving_between_chapters_renames_rules TODO test explicitly defer same-chapter identity preservation, cross-namespace rename/reference updates, and redirects without duplicate rules. That deferral also accounts for local-name renaming and rejecting stale specification/implementation/test references despite aliases: the redirect tests establish output-only alias creation, not complete inventory/reference integration. The prerequisite remains a focused move/rename fixture exercising canonical inventory and reference validation together with redirect publication, including unchanged chapter-local moves and stale-reference rejection. The empty TODO body is accepted solely as explicit pending work, not behavioral evidence. No N/A entries exist. The existing rationale remains sufficient with these limitations; no edits requested.

Method: inspected current captured claim, complete source files, association metadata and test bodies; recorded additional helper dependencies with review read. Personally executed review start/read and the historical byte comparison; no behavioral tests or workspace build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator reports 321 sage-meta tests and cargo build passing separately; these are not reviewer execution results.
